public_rationale: Anthropic publicly linked added compute capacity to higher usage limits on May 6, before the post. Those changes included doubling Claude Code's five-hour limits and removing peak-hour reductions. On the ordinary reading that product improvements include increased usable service, this contradicts the statement that neither company's products improve with compute availability. The finding does not establish improved model intelligence.
limitations: The verdict depends on including service capacity within product improvement.
If Zitron intended only intrinsic model capability, this item would not settle that narrower claim.
The causal attribution is Anthropic's own disclosure, not an independent experiment.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Neither OpenAI nor Anthropic appears unable to serve customers, apart from Claude's lousy uptime, and neither appears to improve its products based on the availability of compute.

statement.excerpt: Neither appears to be unable to serve customers — other than the lousy uptime of Claude — nor do they appear to improve their products based on the availability of compute.

from_speaker: Neither appears to be unable to serve customers
other than the lousy uptime of Claude
nor do they appear to improve their products
based on the availability of compute
our_interpretation: I read 'appears' as a statement about publicly observable evidence, rather than an uncheckable personal impression.
Because this describes a current operational state, I use Q2 2026 through the post date, the latest reporting period for which dated operational announcements could be public.
Serving customers includes satisfying usage demand; a company need not be completely offline to face capacity constraints.
Product improvements ordinarily include higher usable service limits, as well as better model capabilities. Claude outages alone do not count against the claim.
A documented counterexample at either company defeats the statement that neither company benefits in these ways.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporaneous operational evidence establishes adequate capacity to meet customer demand apart from the excluded Claude outages, and supports the asserted absence of product improvements attributable to available compute at both companies.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Dated evidence within the target period documents a capacity-driven service restriction or an actual product improvement attributable to additional compute at either company, beyond Claude uptime alone.
